schedules.topic: Inference-Time Guardrails: Implementing Deterministic Safety Filters Without Latency Penalties
schedules.description: Explores architectural patterns for securing user prompts and model outputs using dual-pass validation, lightweight classifier models like Llama Guard, and asynchronous guardrail execution to protect production applications from prompt injection and data leaks.

schedules.topic: LangChain: Moving from LLM Calls to AI Applications
schedules.description: Explore how LangChain helps structure AI applications using prompts, chains, memory, agents, and reusable components. Focus on moving from simple model calls toward multi-step AI workflows.

Explore how to build an AI agent capable of understanding engineering tasks, modifying code, executing workflows, and creating pull requests. Discuss combining LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, and Codex.
